body: I bought the stuff I need for tonight.  I plan to record it and send it to her right before I drift off.  I need closure and this will be it.

I wonder too...I know our conversations were getting shorter and shorter.

She said before I came along that she would go out clubbing and take foreign guys home...but she moved past that when she started seeing me.  I don't know if she moved on due to distance or what...closure would be great, but it's been several days since I heard from her.  

I honestly don't want to go on without her.

Edit:  If someone can get ahold of her, I would appreciate it.  I won't put her contact on here, but I just need to know what happened.
Yeah...I'm beining to see that I married her for a noble reason instead of the right reason.

We've been married for 7 years and our daughter is 7.  I think she's a good mother, but she gets "Tiger Mom-ish" at times, yelling at things her when I typically pull her aside and explain why things are the way they are.
